signals.text: At after school club we offer outdoor activities (light and weather permitting) that make full use of our brilliant outdoor facilities and a range of indoor activities for the whole group including construction, den building, reading and cooking with exciting developments to come!
signals.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Wraparound Care

signals.text: Children can attend Breakfast club from 7.45am and are provided with a healthy breakfast and all the children find this to be a fun and engaging way to start the school day.
signals.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Wraparound Care

signals.text: The clubs are run by Mrs Rachel MacKinder, Mrs Steph Norton and Mrs Charlotte Archer - experienced school staff who know our children exceptionally well.
signals.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Wraparound Care

signals.text: We also offer an After School Club from 3.15 until 6pm (5pm on Fridays) with the option of a half session finishing by 4.30pm - healthy snacks are provided to keep the energy levels high!
signals.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Wraparound Care

signals.text: Our Christian ethos encourages children to realise that ‘With Christ, we can step forward with courage to achieve beyond expectations’, supported by our values of respect, kindness, togetherness and perseverance.
signals.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Headteacher's Welcome

signals.text: Our school vision incorporates our ethos: "With Christ we can step forward, with courage, to achieve beyond expectations".
signals.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Vision & Values

signals.text: Alongside our school’s vision and values, we agree with and promote our core British Values which are: • respect for all others • supporting liberty and equality • understanding the need for Human Rights and Freedom of Speech • being responsible for and holding dear the democratic society in which we live.
signals.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Vision & Values

signals.text: As a church school we want all children to know they are valued and understand they have a place in a Christian school community regardless of their own personal faith or beliefs.
Our Vision & Values "I can do all this through Christ who gives me strength." Philippians 4:13 We have chosen this bible verse to underpin all we do at Rushall Primary School.

With Christ we can step forward with courage to achieve beyond expectations
Kindness
Respect
Perseverance
Togetherness
Welcome to Rushall CE Primary School
a member of the EQUA MEAD LEARNING trust
Here at Rushall Church of England Primary School we are all very proud of our warm and welcoming atmosphere.
As a church school we want all children to know they are valued and understand they have a place in a Christian school community regardless of their own personal faith or beliefs. We have learning and high standards at the heart of all we do, rooted in our Christian value of courage.
“I can do all this through CHRIST who gives me strength” Philippians 4:13
Our Classes
Rossetti

pageCache.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Religious Education and Collective Worship
pageCache.text:
Our Religious Education and Collective Worship
Stronger together in learning and play
Respectful and resilient in every way
The school's Christian foundation, links to our local church communities and the support from the Salisbury Diocese mean that our learning across the curriculum is rooted in our Christian values of togetherness, respect and resilience.
The bible verse that underpins our Christian ethos is from Philippians Chapter 3 verse 14. It states "I can do all this through Christ who gives me strength". St Paul, the apostle made it his mission to spread the word of Jesus far and wide after the crucifixion and resurrection. He set up a church at Philippi (in modern day Greece) and regularly sent letters of encouragement back to the people there. It is from one of these letters encouraging the Philippians to show strength and resilience in adversity that our verse is taken from.
Collective Worship at Rushall Primary School
At Rushall CE Primary School, the children participate in a daily act of worship. This is either a whole school worship in the hall or a class based worship. At the start of our whole school collective worship, we light a candle and say:
"The candle is lit...Jesus is with us.
We are very fortunate to welcome members of our local community, known as "Open the Book", who help the children to perform bible stories once a week. The Vale of Pewsey Team Rector, Revd Canon Rhona Floate also comes in regularly to school to lead a Worship for us. We also invite parents and carers to celebrate the children's achievements every Friday morning in Celebration Worship.
Our collective worship follows the "Roots and Fruits" programme which addresses Christian values across a two year cycle. Once a term our Worship Council hold a collective worship that the children themselves plan and lead. The children decide on the content and message for their worship to fit in with the current collective worship theme.
We also celebrate with songs, stories and prayer. We usually finish our worship with our own school prayer.
Help us to step forward to achieve,
as we learn and play together .
We can do this through your strength.
The candle is then put out and we say together:
'May the light of Jesus always shine in our hearts.'

pageCache.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Vision & Values
pageCache.text:
Our Vision & Values
"I can do all this through Christ who gives me strength."
Philippians 4:13
We have chosen this bible verse to underpin all we do at Rushall Primary School. We acknowledge that God can provide all the strength we need to go about our daily lives and to enable us to achieve.
Our long-standing school ethos,
reminds us that we are never truly alone and we are supported in all that we do.
Our school vision incorporates our ethos:
"With Christ we can step forward, with courage, to achieve beyond expectations".
we know that if we have faith in God and are trusting in him, he can give us the courage we need to push ourselves beyond what we ever though was possible.
Our inspiring Biblical character is David and the story of his encounter with Goliath, which we believe exemplifies our vision. David trusted in God and discovered that through his faith in God’s power, he was able to overcome the difficulties he encountered. We hope that David’s story will inspire our pupils to live out our school vision.
Our school values help us to live out our vision:
Our core value is Courage – we want to step out of our comfort zones to make decisions and take actions for the good of ourselves and others.
• Respect - We respect others by promoting self-worth and allowing all to flourish, regardless of our backgrounds, religions, views or abilities.
• Kindness - We display kindness to each other and practice forgiveness and reconciliation.
• Togetherness - We build togetherness within a safe environment, which results in a caring community that openly encourages others to flourish and grow as individuals. We create a sense of belonging that embraces and celebrates difference. We reach out to those in need; make connections beyond our walls and seek to benefit the wider world.
• Perseverance - We show perseverance by overcoming barriers to our own learning and through making positive choices. We have resilience to cope well when things are difficult.
At Rushall we know that each individuals’ ‘Spirituality’ is vital. We believe that even though spirituality cannot be seen, it can be felt. Spirituality allows us understanding of our whole self; all that we are and all we hold dear. Our spirituality empowers us with strength and courage to ask big questions, enabling us to make a positive impact on our community and change the world. We aim to provide time and opportunities to reflect and develop spiritually throughout our school journey.
Alongside our school’s vision and values, we agree with and promote our core British Values which are:
• respect for all others
• supporting liberty and equality
• understanding the need for Human Rights and Freedom of Speech
• being responsible for and holding dear the democratic society in which we live.

pageCache.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Headteacher's Welcome
pageCache.text:
Our Headteacher's Welcome
Welcome to Rushall Church of England Primary School: a small village school with strong ties to our community set in beautiful grounds. Our Christian ethos encourages children to realise that ‘With Christ, we can step forward with courage to achieve beyond expectations’, supported by our values of respect, kindness, togetherness and perseverance. Our staff team is committed to providing the best education and opportunities for all of the children in our care so that they thrive and feel valued every day.
We are a family-orientated school and we strive to know our children and families extremely well, ensuring we have a collaborative approach to supporting them along their learning journey. We have high expectations for all our pupils and we provide them with opportunities to challenge themselves, develop confidence and reach their full potential in readiness for secondary school.
We would encourage you to visit our school so that we can show you around and give you time to meet our wonderful children and staff.

pageCache.pageTitle: Rushall CE VA School - Our Wraparound Care
pageCache.text:
Our Wraparound Care
We offer an amazing provision for Rushall children to help working parents over and above the normal school day. The clubs are run by Mrs Rachel MacKinder, Mrs Steph Norton and Mrs Charlotte Archer - experienced school staff who know our children exceptionally well.
Children can attend Breakfast club from 7.45am and are provided with a healthy breakfast and all the children find this to be a fun and engaging way to start the school day.
We also offer an After School Club from 3.15 until 6pm (5pm on Fridays) with the option of a half session finishing by 4.30pm - healthy snacks are provided to keep the energy levels high!
At after school club we offer outdoor activities (light and weather permitting) that make full use of our brilliant outdoor facilities and a range of indoor activities for the whole group including construction, den building, reading and cooking with exciting developments to come!
There is a charge for this wrap around care, but we try to keep costs to families to a minimum and Child Care Vouchers are accepted for these activities.
Please contact the school office or complete the booking through Arbor.
